title.zh: 币安为遵守巴西央行新规限制服务并下架代币
title.en: Binance will hold some Brazil crypto deposits until users explain where the money came from

current_state.zh: 为遵守巴西新的加密货币法规，币安将在巴西限制其八项服务并下架22种代币。
current_state.en: Binance will restrict eight of its services and delist 22 tokens in Brazil to comply with the country's new cryptocurrency regulations.

updates.title_zh: 币安将暂扣部分巴西加密存款，直至用户说明资金来源
updates.title_en: Binance will hold some Brazil crypto deposits until users explain where the money came from
updates.what_changed_zh: 币安将暂扣部分巴西加密存款，直至用户提供资金 origin 证明文件，从而在该市场加强对入账转账的 AML/资金来源审查。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance will withhold certain Brazilian crypto deposits until users document the origin of the funds, tightening AML/source-of-funds checks on inbound transfers in that market.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安将暂扣部分巴西加密存款，直至用户提供资金 origin 证明文件，从而在该市场加强对入账转账的 AML/资金来源审查。
updates.current_state_en: Binance will withhold certain Brazilian crypto deposits until users document the origin of the funds, tightening AML/source-of-funds checks on inbound transfers in that market.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance will withhold certain Brazilian crypto deposits until users document the origin of the funds, tightening AML/source-of-funds checks on inbound transfers in that market.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance will withhold certain Brazilian crypto deposits until users document the origin of the funds, tightening AML/source-of-funds checks on inbound transfers in that market.

updates.title_zh: 币安将从 11 月 1 日起阻止无用途的巴西跨境加密转账
updates.title_en: Binance to Block Brazil Cross-Border Crypto Transfers From Nov. 1 Without Purpos
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增：未完成问卷的提款将被阻止；信息不完整的存款可能保持待处理或被退回；5万美元以下转账使用10类用途列表，以上需从96种分类中选择；对手方未获巴西外汇市场授权时部分转账上限为10万美元；巴西居民间转账不受影响。
updates.what_changed_en: Added: withdrawals will be blocked without the completed questionnaire; incomplete deposits may remain pending or be returned; transfers up to $50,000 use a 10-purpose list while larger ones require one of 96 classifications; some transfers are capped at $100,000 if the counterparty is not FX-authorized in Brazil; transfers between Brazilian residents are unaffected.
updates.current_state_zh: 自11月1日起，币安将要求巴西用户申报跨境加密转账的用途和交易对手，未完成问卷的提款将被阻止，信息不完整的存款可能被退回，并向巴西央行按月报告；部分转账若对手方未获巴西外汇授权，上限为10万美元。
updates.current_state_en: From Nov. 1, Binance will require Brazilian users to declare the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers, block withdrawals without the questionnaire, potentially return incomplete deposits, report transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank, and cap some transfers at $100,000 where the counterparty is not FX-authorized in Brazil.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance will require Brazilian users to declare the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers starting Nov. 1, blocking withdrawals without the questionnaire, potentially returning incomplete deposits, and reporting the transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank under Resolution BCB No. 521/2025, which caps some transfers at $100,000 where the counterparty is not FX-authorized in Brazil.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance will require Brazilian users to declare the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers starting Nov. 1, blocking withdrawals without the questionnaire, potentially returning incomplete deposits, and reporting the transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank under Resolution BCB No. 521/2025, which caps some transfers at $100,000 where the counterparty is not FX-authorized in Brazil.

updates.title_zh: Binance 将在巴西限制 8 项服务并下架 22 种代币以遵守新规
updates.title_en: Binance to Restrict 8 Services and Delist 22 Tokens in Brazil to Comply With New
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance 将从 10 月 27 日起对巴西用户限制八项服务并停止 22 种代币的交易，并在 10 月 29 日前将其迁移至当地集团实体，以遵守央行新的加密法规。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance will restrict eight services and halt trading in 22 tokens for Brazilian users starting October 27 and migrate them to a local group entity by October 29 to comply with new central bank crypto regulations.

updates.title_en: Binance Restricts 8 Services and Delists 22 Tokens in Brazil
updates.what_changed_zh: Binance 已对巴西用户限制八项服务并下架 22 种代币，以应对该国的监管与合规要求，收紧其本地业务。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance has restricted eight services and delisted 22 tokens for users in Brazil, tightening its local offering in response to the country's regulatory and compliance requirements.
